# Dynamics of biomass in fire prone savanna in central Africa :fire:

## Context
Development at CIRAD (UMR AMAP). Numerical simulation of the interactions between woody and herbaceous biomass in fire prone savanna in 2D

## Methods
- System of semi-linear parabolic PDEs
- Continuous finite elements with the mass lumping method
- Non-standard linearisation of the RHS (for positivity preserving purpose)
- Satellite data processing script (Python, Julia)

## Stack
Fortran 90 - MUMPS - Make - ParaView - Python - Julia - Institutional GitLab

## Statut
🔧 Writing of the article on the numerical schema study is in progress. 
Code repository to be released upon publication of the article.
